In-Game Transmog Picker v3.0 (MHFU ULJM05500, FUComplete v1.4.0)
Item box -> Arrange Items -> Equipment: pick up the piece whose look you want (Circle), move to
the piece that should get it and press Square. Square on the picked-up piece itself resets it.
See ingame/README.md.
